name: What Are You Building
description: Catalogs indie builders and their AI/SaaS products worldwide by category and country. Exposes a public JSON API and MCP server for agent discovery; free community listings, human-reviewed.

skills.name: Product Discovery
skills.description: Searches and filters a global directory of indie AI and SaaS products by category, country, and keyword via a JSON API.

skills.name: MCP Access
skills.description: Exposes the product catalog to AI agents over an MCP server for programmatic browse and lookup.

skills.name: Free Listings
skills.description: Lets makers submit products for free; each listing is human-reviewed before it appears in the public directory.
